items.evidence_summary: The official Tready careers page currently states that the agency often looks for freelance profiles and exposes role-specific choices including Sviluppatore web and Web designer. The official company site confirms a substantial web delivery practice spanning sites, e-commerce, WooCommerce, web maintenance, web development, redesign, landing pages, performance-oriented sites, SEO and automation/AI services.
items.why_high_value: Strong overlap with VDS WordPress/frontend/WooCommerce/performance/maintenance/web-design capabilities and explicit willingness to work with freelancers inside an established Italian digital agency, creating potential recurring overflow or specialist collaboration value.
verified_facts: Official careers page says Tready often seeks freelance profiles.
Official careers form exposes Sviluppatore web and Web designer as application roles.
The authoritative route is an application form that requests a CV upload.
Official site lists web development, WooCommerce, web maintenance, redesign, landing pages and performance-focused site work.
Tready identifies itself as a digital marketing/web agency based in Lecco and operating throughout Italy.
info@tready.it is publicly listed, but the careers page provides a dedicated application form instead of designating that address as the application recipient.
inferences: The explicit freelance language is evergreen collaboration demand rather than proof of a dated project-specific vacancy.
VDS is plausibly suitable for web development/design overflow, but no specific assignment volume or immediate project need is guaranteed.
safe_alternative_angles: Manual application through the official careers form for Sviluppatore web or Web designer, emphasizing verified WordPress/frontend/WooCommerce/performance/maintenance strengths.
Position VDS Engine only at benefit level: fast, maintainable, pragmatic implementation and quality/performance discipline.
do_not_bypass_constraints: Do not substitute info@tready.it for the dedicated careers form without authoritative evidence that it accepts applications.
Do not upload a CV unless the exact immutable file is owner-approved under governance/approved-attachments.json.
Do not claim a current project-specific vacancy or guaranteed workload from evergreen freelance language.
Presence in human review does not authorize automatic outreach.
recommended_human_checks: Choose Sviluppatore web or Web designer based on the strongest truthful portfolio fit.
Approve an exact PDF CV artifact before any form submission; the approved-attachments registry is currently empty.
Recheck the official form immediately before any manual submission.
